closed_findings: Parity execution/replay/complete evidence is checked for immutability before plan/staging writes; staging resume requires exact original plan bytes.
Computed replay tensors persist before numerical comparisons; numerical failures retain explicit report and replay evidence and produce no success marker.
Parity required-files map is bound to the exact pinned reference plan/upload, replay checksum and first frozen training context.
Verifier has separate clean full-SHA tracked-script provenance, frozen config/selection/role/runtime, exact verifier/helper bytes and unchanged numerical-source proof.
Parity dictionary file hashes must match every original queued input ledger before source checkpoint validation.
Foreign uploaded execution provenance must match parity report hash, GCP instance/physical GPU/runtime fingerprint, producer244 and rotation.
invariants: Only complete immutable .pt checkpoints may be published using same-filesystem os.link with no overwrite. No coverage, producer-operation or producer-terminal files are copied.

Every foreign source checkpoint is staged and validated before active-root lineage or component publication; validation binds exact producer, readiness, captures, generation hashes, canonical x, seeds, lengths, full rollout means, pooled means, reconstruction/noise identities and token statistic contracts.

The original producer remains the sole writer of coverage and terminal state. Existing destination files are preserved and semantically validated. The original may subsequently atomically replace a published cache with its valid result.
Hash plus deserialize use one open inode. Publication event hashes record an observation, not a promise about the path after a later original-producer replacement.
Lineage is atomically published before any optional tensor file. Partial publication is recoverable without replacing existing files; final original coverage records its observed actual bytes.
remaining_required_before_actual_reuse: Review concrete foreign precompute launcher and complete-split adoption plans, including clean verifier commit and exact immutable244/v4 invocation, unique source root/prefix, original plan bytes and success terminal paths.
Run and durably upload exact zero-tolerance all-k parity on the actual one-physical-A10080 worker before foreign computation. Numerical replay failure forbids reuse.

Future launcher must create execution provenance from a fresh fingerprint on that same worker/runtime, bound to the uploaded passed parity report, before unchanged producer244/v4 execution. Do not derive a current worker claim by merely copying the parity fingerprint.
Require verified complete foreign validation/test uploads and run full driver verify-only before any active-root publication; bind the concrete resulting source receipt and plan hashes.

Check actual disk headroom and same-filesystem atomic hardlink feasibility, immutable capture/dictionary/readiness closure and absence of active-prefix collision; retain primary null scheduling priority.
Keep original queue, plans, numerical source, coverage and terminal ownership unchanged; preserve partial failures and fully verify required uploads before deleting artifacts or releasing resources.
limitations: Current proof covers code and immutable reference metadata only. No actual foreign split, worker parity output or adoption plan exists in this reviewed bundle.
A first-context exact parity check is a numerical compatibility gate for the same pinned code, inputs, runtime and worker. It is not a mathematical proof of equality for arbitrary other contexts.
Worker fingerprint physical GPU ordinal0 matches the intended one-physical-GPU VM domain; this review does not authorize remapped multi-GPU/MIG execution.
